image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a sea lion resting on a rocky surface. The animal is curled up, with its head tucked towards its body. The fur appears wet and coarse, ranging from dark brown to black. One foreflipper is visible near the bottom left, appearing dark and leathery. The background consists of out-of-focus grey rocks.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A small, distinct flap-like structure is visible on the side of the head, consistent with the external ear pinnae of a sea lion, distinguishing it from true seals which lack external ears.
The resolution and angle do not allow for clear visualization of individual whiskers. The snout area is somewhat blurry and angled away.
